desc: Prove the tree/forest interpretation of valid substrings and operations, including the arbitrary sibling-permutation reachability claim.
Derive the orbit-size formula as a product of local multinomial counts, accounting for identical unordered child subtree types.
Build the parse tree, canonicalize unordered subtree types bottom-up, and implement the count in Python for \(N \le 5000\).
Validate the formula against public sample tests.
